project_info.title: Rainy neon street walk phone vlog

prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with loosely half-tied long dark hair wears an oversized vintage striped winter sweater.
prompt.composition_elements: Shaky handheld following shot from behind on a wet sidewalk; delayed autofocus resolves as she looks back, smiles, steps closer, and tucks wet hair behind her ear.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Mixed neon signage and wet-street reflections with delayed autofocus, motion blur, lens flare, and strong phone-video grain.

technical_specs.camera: Continuous handheld smartphone POV with amateur framing and high-ISO noise.
technical_specs.motion: Walk, stop, look back, step closer, and tuck hair.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Low-quality smartphone vlog footage, shaky handheld camera POV. An adult woman with long loosely half-tied hair walks ahead on a wet street on a rainy night, wearing an oversized vintage chunky winter sweater. Colorful neon lights reflect on the wet pavement. Use high-ISO noise and dynamic motion blur. She stops, turns back to look directly at the camera as delayed autofocus shifts from soft to sharp, and gives a casual, sweet, slightly shy smile. Her hair is slightly wet from drizzle. She takes one step closer to the lens and tucks a wet strand behind her ear. Keep amateur framing, lens flares, heavy video grain, and raw unpolished continuous-shot aesthetic.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, minor, watermark, plastic skin, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference is mandatory. Preserve adult subject, wet neon street, look-back beat, and raw smartphone texture. Keep the subject fully clothed and the interaction friendly.
